text: New Tracking tab: logs such as blood glucose can be switched off, which hides them and stops their reminders. Nothing recorded is deleted.
Logs that are switched off no longer appear on this page.
Admin has a Tracking group. Admin choices beat Doctor and User choices.
Doctors has a Tracking group. Doctor choices beat User choices. A locked log names who locked it.
New padlock button: unlock the layout to move panels with Earlier and Later or by dragging. Nothing can be entered while unlocked.
The old Weight on screen switch is gone. Weight is now turned on or off under Tracking.
Unlocked panels can be resized by dragging an edge or corner, or with the Size button. Each panel can have its own text size.
A panel's Size button opens settings in a bar at the bottom, so no panel changes size while open. The chosen panel has a thick outline.
